name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1860: The vault gate decided whether a frame may speak about ownership by asking which stash tab was selected. That question abstains whenever two or more labels are legible - correctly, because the strip prints all five whichever is active - and the gate read the abstention as not a stash. So the clearest evidence his stash is open refused exactly like an empty frame. Measured on his own reels: four frames printed PERSONAL SHARED GEMS MATERIALS in one strip and all four were turned away. Admission now counts legible labels; one is proof, four is overwhelming, and the tab stays honestly unknown.
